user.title: Luftwächter
user.description: Rooms are found from your areas. Pick a weather entity for outside hints (optional).

init.title: Luftwächter options
init.description: Rooms are rated against these limits. CO₂ and fine dust are adjustable; temperature and humidity use fixed comfort ranges.

data.stale_minutes: Warn when data is older than

data_description.excluded_areas: Areas that should not appear in the panel (for example a garage or a cellar).
data_description.rain_sensor: Optional. A binary sensor that is on while it rains. Left empty, Luftwächter looks for one named rain or Regen.
data_description.mold_rh: Relative humidity (%) from which a room counts as mold risk. Default 70.
data_description.stale_minutes: Minutes without an update before the panel shows a warning.
data_description.outside_temp_sensor: Optional. A real outdoor temperature sensor. Left empty, the weather entity is used.
data_description.reminder_first: Minutes a window must be open before the first reminder. Default 10.
data_description.reminder_repeat: Minutes between repeated reminders while the window stays open. Default 5.
data_description.reminder_below: Only remind when it is colder than this outside. Default 10.
data_description.reminder_from: First hour (0 to 23) in which reminders may come. Default 8.
data_description.reminder_to: Reminders stop at this hour. Default 22.
data_description.mute_entities: If any of these switches or binary sensors is on, no reminders come (for example a charging window).
data_description.ignored_windows: Windows that never trigger a reminder.

error.limits_order: The "good" limit must be lower than the "fair" limit.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Recalculate all rooms now instead of waiting for the next update.

no_rooms.title: Luftwächter finds no rooms
no_rooms.description: No area has a CO₂, fine dust, temperature or humidity sensor yet. Assign your sensors to an area (Settings → Areas, labels & zones). Rooms appear here by themselves as soon as a sensor reports values.
